full_prompt_en: A square, softly textured oil painting places two women in dark formal dresses before a vast pale city panorama. The nearer woman stands slightly left of center, facing forward with a composed, almost vacant expression. Short blond curls frame her pale face; a narrow white lace collar and dark ribbon tie brighten the upper edge of her black dress. A second woman stands behind and to the right, darker-haired and less distinct, her face half lost in the shimmering atmosphere. At the left edge, a third partial figure is only loosely visible. Low across the foreground, small tables carry glasses and pale dishes, suggesting an outdoor café or terrace. Beyond the women, the city spreads across almost the entire background as a dense, indistinct pattern of rooftops, towers, and pale blocks under a clouded gray-blue sky. A dark vertical boundary at the right edge and muted foliage around the figures frame the view without enclosing it. The faces are handled gently with creamy highlights and subdued pink lips, but the background and garments are broken into countless short, restless strokes. Black dresses absorb much of the lower light; gold-gray flecks, cool slate, and cream-white glints vibrate around them. Daylight is diffuse, with no hard shadow or clear sun direction, giving the scene a strange suspension between interior social stillness and distant urban immensity. The foreground figures are close yet emotionally remote, their fixed gazes contrasting with the loose, almost dissolving city. The color remains muted and slightly tarnished rather than bright. The whole painting feels enigmatic and quietly theatrical, using a shallow group of pale faces against an unusually deep, flickering horizon.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、肌理柔和的油画把两名穿深色正式裙装的女子置于辽阔浅色城市全景前。前方女子站在中央稍左，正面朝前，神情端正、近乎茫然。短金卷发框住浅色面容；窄白蕾丝领与深色丝带结点亮黑裙上缘。第二名女子站在后方偏右，发色较深，形象较为模糊，面容半隐于闪烁的空气里。左边缘仅松散可见第三人的部分身影。前景低处，小桌上有玻璃杯与浅色餐具，暗示露天咖啡馆或露台。女子身后，城市几乎铺满整个背景，屋顶、塔尖与浅色楼块在灰蓝多云天空下组成密集却难以分辨的图案。右边缘深色竖向界线和人物周围低调植物框住景色，却没有封闭它。面孔以奶油色亮部和含蓄粉唇轻柔处理，背景与衣服则被无数短小躁动笔触打碎。黑裙吸走下方大部分光线；金灰色碎点、冷板岩色及奶油白微光在周围振动。日光漫射，没有硬阴影或明确太阳方向，使场景在近处社交静止与远方城市浩瀚之间奇异地悬置。前景人物距离很近，情感上却疏离；固定目光与松散、几乎消融的城市形成对照。色彩低调、略带暗哑，而非鲜亮。整幅画神秘而安静戏剧化，以浅色面孔构成的近景小群对抗不寻常深远、闪烁的地平景色。
style_prompt_en: A softly worked oil painting sets a few calm pale focal forms against an expansive, flickering field of tiny marks. Charcoal black masses occupy the lower foreground, lifted by small cream highlights, muted rose, and warm gray. The distant field is built from broken gold-gray, slate-blue, and olive strokes that suggest detail without fully resolving it. Diffuse daylight removes hard cast shadows, letting boundaries shimmer and soften. A dark upright at one side anchors the broad horizontal spread behind it. The nearest forms retain clear, restrained modeling, while successive layers dissolve into granular atmosphere. The palette is subdued and slightly tarnished, creating a still, enigmatic mood in which close presence and far depth remain equally important.
style_prompt_zh: 柔和处理的油画将少量安静浅色焦点形体置于由细小痕迹构成的辽阔闪烁色域前。炭黑色大块占据下方前景，由奶油白微光、低调玫瑰色与暖灰色抬起。远处区域以破碎金灰、板岩蓝及橄榄色笔触建成，暗示细节却不完全辨明。漫射日光消除坚硬投影，让边界闪动、软化。一侧的深色竖向形体固定身后宽阔水平展开。最近的形体保留清楚而克制的塑形，后续层次则逐渐消融于颗粒空气。色域含蓄、略微暗哑，形成静止神秘的气氛，近处存在与远方深度同样重要。
theme_en: Two women in dark dresses stand before a hazy city seen from a café terrace
theme_zh: 两名穿深色连衣裙的女子站在咖啡馆露台前，身后是朦胧城市
name: Paul Delvaux
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
